entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-12
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Support native SQL Server MERGE statement inside SaveChanges batching #39235

Closed

  • ToString() on an enum with a string value converter fails in projections on EF 11 ("No coercion operator is defined"), possible regression from #38156 #39146
    11.0.0
  • ExecuteDelete reports CommandSource.ExecuteUpdate to interceptors and diagnostics #39186
    10.0.15

PullRequests

Created

  • Cast to the closed ValueConverter<,> in the precompiled shaper #39236
    community-contribution
  • Add AggregateFunctionExpression as a relational base for provider aggregate functions #39234
    community-contribution
  • Use CreateTempSubdirectory for temporary directories #39233
  • Don't apply optimized null expansion to the projection of an IN subquery #39232
    community-contribution
  • Return the starting position for IndexOf with an empty string on SQL … #39231
    community-contribution
  • Fix Not on bool? and Increment/Decrement on non-int types in LinqToCS… #39230
    community-contribution
  • Keep fractional seconds in SQL Server TimeSpan literals #39229
    community-contribution
  • Convert unsigned enums to decimal through their underlying type #39228
    community-contribution
  • Read TimeOnly values stored as REAL in Microsoft.Data.Sqlite #39227
    community-contribution

Merged

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39226
  • [release/11.0] Fix Cosmos concurrency tests by normalizing ETag comparisons #39215
    area-test
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39191
  • Correct remaining SQLite schema metadata #39219
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.DotNet.XUnitV3Extensions from 11.0.0-beta.26473.115 to 11.0.0-beta.26509.3 #39212
    area-infrastructure

Updated

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39205
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.CodeCoverage from 18.11.2 to 18.12.0 #39213
    area-infrastructure
  • Make the evals more realistic and improve the skills accordingly #39217
    area-harness
  • Add experimental ExecuteMerge / upsert support #39100
    community-contribution
  • Log FirstWithoutOrderByAndFilterWarning for First on a collection navigation in a subquery #39218
    community-contribution
